purpose: Test-case list for the history stage: notable Montana weather events 2020 to 2026 with dates, places, measured values and the products that should show each one.

window.note: B2 history window is the 1,826 SPC days ending at the build date; events before 2021-10-19 are marked in_b2_window false.

time_rules.IEM LSR VALID: UTC (confirmed: Benchland report VALID 202506152010 is the 20:10 UTC report in the B2 brief; NCEI-to-LSR matched hail pairs differ by +7 h in 768 of 932 pairs, so NCEI BEGIN_DATE_TIME is UTC-7 standard time)
time_rules.NCEI BEGIN_DATE_TIME: local standard time, UTC-7 (see above); 62 matched pairs differ by +6 h, not explained here
time_rules.IEM daily: local calendar day; GHCN daily is a separate day definition (one-day offsets seen, e.g. Great Falls 2024-01-12 vs 01-13)
time_rules.SPC day: 12:00 UTC day D to 11:59 UTC day D+1 (B1 day key); used for B1 store probes

grid_rule.finding: Python float arithmetic and exact decimal arithmetic disagree on exact half-cell points. The LSR point 47.08 N, 110.02 W is row 791.5 exactly: round-half-even gives 792 (exact), Python float gives 791. The same happens at Petrolia Lake (lon 108.25 W, column 2174.5: exact 2174, float 2175). Both values are recorded for each place; the build needs one stated rule (integer thousandths).

method: Live requests made 2026-10-19 with curl; each response's HTTP status and byte count are logged in fetch-log.tsv and listed in sources; bodies were content-checked (CSV headers, row counts, value spot checks, JSON fields).

Large NCEI StormEvents details files for 2021 to 2026 were read in place from the B2 cache (/home/user/hail-b2/out/joins/cache/ncei); each cache file's byte size equals the live NCEI directory listing. The 2020 file was downloaded (10,444,606 bytes, equal to the listing).

GHCN-Daily by_station files for four stations were downloaded in full (58.2 MB) because element blocks are interleaved and tail ranges do not cover the window; quality-flagged rows were excluded from statistics.
Watchwarn (TO, FF, SV), zone-product CSVs and daily station gusts were read from the B2 cache; the 2020 station gusts were pulled live.
Point-in-polygon tests for severe thunderstorm polygons used the even-odd rule on the cached shapefile rings (pyshp read from zip in memory; nothing extracted to disk).
Storm-report coordinates are the report's own LAT and LON; ASOS coordinates are from the IEM network list; NWS PNS statements are quoted as printed.

Total bytes downloaded in this run: 79566927 (sum of HTTP 200 and 206 bodies in the request log). The downloads folder is deleted at the end of the run; scripts and logs are kept under the scratch folder.

open_questions: Which rule does the build use for half-cell points? Python float maps the Benchland LSR point (47.08 N) to row 791; exact decimal maps it to 792 (the B1 brief uses row 792 for Benchland's own cell). Pick one (integer thousandths) and test it.
NCEI BEGIN_DATE_TIME: UTC-7 for most matched hail pairs (768 of 932) but UTC-6 for 62. Find the rule before using NCEI times in the gate.
Tornado timing: NCEI start and LSR touchdown for the Hays tornado (2021-07-07 00:11 and 00:18 UTC) precede the TFX TO issued at 02:20 UTC. Does the TO cover that track, or is it for another storm?
The NCEI Winnett hail (3.50 in) and the LSR Petrolia report (3.50 in) are the same storm; confirm the NCEI and LSR pairing before the gate uses it.

Several store probes miss the report: Lewistown 2.50 in reads 0.0 mm at its cell and 8.9 mm within 5 cells; Glendive 4.00 in reads 14.4 mm at its cell. The build's wording must not say the store confirms a report.
IEM daily and GHCN disagree by more than 1 F on many days (for example Billings 2021-07-19: IEM 106 F, GHCN 107.1 F). Which source is shown on the sheet, and is the difference shown?
The Billings 111 F reading on 2026-07-12 (IEM daily and hourly ASOS agree) needs the NWS climate report before the test list calls it a record.
The USGS instantaneous and NCEI crest values differ at Corwin Springs (14.72 vs 13.88 ft). Which series should the test use?
B2 counts 2,240 severe thunderstorm events in the window; this run counts 2,126 distinct NEW events with centroids in the Montana box. Which box and key does B2 use?
